scope: GLB structure, decoded accessor data, static scene bounds, material references, full image decoding
limitations: This tool is not the Khronos glTF Validator and does not certify visual quality, topology, UV appearance, or animation behavior.
Y-up is the glTF convention; the intended front (+Z), upright appearance, and functional pivot require visual inspection.
Bounds describe stored static mesh positions with node transforms; skins, morph weights, animation, and GPU instancing are not evaluated.

world_bounds.units: glTF meters, without claiming generated scale is physically calibrated

pivot_and_scale.raw_axis_convention: glTF Y-up; intended object front +Z is NOT VERIFIED

shutter_partition_validation.uv_method: Source UV values interpolated linearly at every plane intersection; original material and all source images preserved

uncapped_cut_contours.reason: Nested contours need hole-aware triangulation; left uncapped
Nested contours need hole-aware triangulation; left uncapped

runtime_path_validation.collision_validation: Not performed; bounds alone do not establish collision-free motion
